# i386 objects, compared whole with GNU as's (see run.sh).

=== references to symbols in their own section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias, func
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .type   func, %function
        .hidden lhid
start:
        call loc
        call glob
        call weak1
        call hid
        call prot
        call intl
        call whid
        call lhid
        call func
        call late
        call lweak
        call lalias
        call lwalias
        call galias
        call walias
        jmp loc
        jmp glob
        jmp weak1
        jmp lalias
        jmp walias
        jz loc
        jz glob
        jz weak1
        jz lalias
        jz walias
        call loc@PLT
        call glob@PLT
        call weak1@PLT
        call lalias@PLT
        call galias@PLT
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
lhid:   nop
func:   nop
late:   nop
lweak:  nop
        .globl  late
        .weak   lweak
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc

=== references back to symbols in their own section
        .text
        .globl  glob
        .weak   weak1
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
        .set    lalias, glob
        call loc
        call glob
        call weak1
        call lalias
        jmp loc
        jmp glob
        jmp weak1
        jz loc
        jz glob
        jz weak1

=== references out of their section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  oglob
        .weak   oweak, uweak
        .set    oalias, oloc
        call oloc
        call oglob
        call oweak
        call oalias
        call ext
        call uweak
        nop
        .section .text.other,"ax"
oloc:   nop
oglob:  nop
oweak:  nop

=== data referring to symbols, by binding
        .data
        .globl  glob, galias, hid
        .weak   weak1, walias
        .weak   uweak
        .hidden hid
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
base:   .long   loc, glob, weak1, hid, lalias, lwalias, galias, walias, ext
        .long   loc - ., glob - ., weak1 - ., lalias - ., walias - .
        .long   glob - base, weak1 - base, base - weak1, lalias - base, walias - base
        .long   ext - ., uweak - .
loc:    .long   0
glob:   .long   0
weak1:  .long   0
hid:    .long   0

=== default section alignment
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
        .bss
        .space  1
        .section .text.hot,"ax"
        .byte   4
        .section .data.rel,"aw"
        .byte   5
        .section .init,"ax"
        .byte   6
        .section custom,"a"
        .byte   7

=== calls and jumps to an undefined symbol
    call ext
    jmp ext
    je ext
    call ext@PLT
    jmp ext@PLT

=== absolute references at every width
    movl $ext, %eax
    movw $ext, %ax
    movb $ext, %al
    movl ext, %eax
    movl ext+4(%ebx), %ecx
    pushl $ext
    addl $ext, %edx
    int $ext
    .long ext
    .word ext
    .byte ext
    .long ext - .

=== far pointers to symbols
    ljmp $0x10, $ext
    lcall $0x10, $ext+8
    ljmp $ext, $0x1000

=== GOT loads GNU as marks relaxable
    movl ext@GOT(%ebx), %eax
    cmpl ext@GOT(%ebx), %ecx
    addl ext@GOT(%ebx), %edx
    testl %esi, ext@GOT(%ebx)
    call *ext@GOT(%ebx)
    jmp *ext@GOT(%ebx)
    pushl ext@GOT(%ebx)
    movl ext@GOT, %eax
    movl ext@GOT+4(%ebx), %eax

=== GOT references the linker cannot relax
    movl %eax, ext@GOT(%ebx)
    leal ext@GOT(%ebx), %eax
    popl ext@GOT(%ebx)
    movzbl ext@GOT(%ebx), %eax
    movl ext@GOT(,%ebx,1), %eax
    movl $ext@GOT, %eax
    .long ext@GOT

=== the GOT itself, and offsets from it
    call 1f
1:  popl %ebx
    addl $_GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_+(.-1b), %ebx
    leal _GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_(%ebx), %eax
    movl ext@GOTOFF(%ebx), %eax
    leal ext@GOTOFF+4(%ebx), %ecx
    movl $ext@GOTOFF, %eax
    .long ext@GOTOFF

=== thread-local storage models
    leal ext@TLSGD(,%ebx,1), %eax
    leal ext@TLSLDM(%ebx), %eax
    leal ext@DTPOFF(%eax), %eax
    movl %gs:ext@NTPOFF, %eax
    movl $ext@TPOFF, %eax
    movl ext@INDNTPOFF, %eax
    movl ext@GOTNTPOFF(%ebx), %eax
    movl ext@GOTTPOFF(%ebx), %eax
    .long ext@DTPOFF

=== 16-bit code: word relocations
    .code16
    call ext
    jmp ext
    jne ext
    movw $ext, %ax
    movw ext, %bx
    movw ext+2(%bx,%si), %cx
    ljmp $0, $ext
    pushw $ext

=== 16-bit code: byte relocations
    .code16
    jcxz ext
    loop ext
    movb $ext, %al

=== 16-bit code: 32-bit operands and addresses keep 32-bit relocations
    .code16
    movl $ext, %eax
    movl ext(%eax), %ebx
    calll ext
    ljmpl $0x10, $ext

=== code16gcc calls are 32-bit
    .code16gcc
    call ext
    jmp ext

=== local symbols are relocated against their section
    movl $local, %eax
    call local
    movl local+2, %ecx
    .data
local:
    .long 0
